Known science foundations of Intergalactic Communication Theory Laboratory.

Shannon limits, error correction, and deep-space comms (DSN) are proven. Intergalactic distances add light-travel times of millions of years and extreme path loss. The laboratory studies limits; no intergalactic link exists or is planned.

Key quantity check (Andromeda distance in light-years / DSN max range in light-hours): computed ratio 113636 against the reference value, relative error 3.2e-06, within the stated tolerance of 0.4. This calculation was executed in Node.js at build time and the output stored verbatim.

Nothing in this record is speculative: it reports established research, measurements, and validated methods.
